async def act(page):
    # Reasoning:
    # - The goal is to "Show all customers" from the current Dashboard page.
    # - The accessibility tree shows a direct link named "Manage Customers" that points to '/index.php/admin/customer/'.
    # - There is a KB function export_customers_csv_via_grid(page, filename) available, but it is specifically for exporting the grid as CSV
    #   (and itself navigates to the Customers page). The task only requests to show the customers list, not to export it, so calling the
    #   export helper would be unnecessary and could trigger a download. Therefore we will NOT call the KB function.
    # - We will click the "Manage Customers" link. Because this click navigates away from the Dashboard, it must be the last action
    #   performed in this function.

    manage_link = page.get_by_role("link", name="Manage Customers")
    # Ensure the link exists before attempting to click
    if await manage_link.count() == 0:
        raise Exception('Manage Customers link not found on the Dashboard')
    # Click the link to navigate to the Customers management page (this is the last action)
    await manage_link.first.click()
